faqKnowledgeBase.question: Are the single-page daily timetables and business ledgers free to download?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: Yes, 100% free with no registration or credit card required. Users can customize their title, shop details, or schedule hours directly in the browser and print or download clean 300 DPI PDFs.

faqKnowledgeBase.question: What is the difference between single-page templates and multi-page workbooks?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: Single-page templates (timetables, weekly planners, business ledgers) are free utility tools. Multi-page workbooks (50+ page kindergarten packs, phonics bundles, puzzle books, greeting card suites) are comprehensive premium packages available for one-time download.

faqKnowledgeBase.question: Can this printable store web app be installed on mobile phones?
faqKnowledgeBase.answer: Yes. It is a full Progressive Web App (PWA). Android users can tap 'Install App' directly in Chrome. Apple iPhone and iPad users can tap the Safari Share button and choose 'Add to Home Screen'.
